# WLKR UI

React and TypeScript source components, a shadcn-compatible registry, and opt-in WLKR typography.

Source: https://github.com/wlkr-si/ui. Build identity: /build-info.json.

## Pixel drawing

[Pixels](/pixels) is the focused drawing page. It reuses the gallery mask editor, ink, centred resize/crop, undo/redo, explicit Share and transparent SVG/PNG exports. React code opens on request. Download grid saves exact dots/hash rows with one final newline in a size-based .txt file accepted by the Pixels CLI; ink stays in links or an explicit --ink flag. New canonical links use /pixels?mask=<token>#pixels; existing root v1/v2 links remain supported. No artwork is saved to a backend or browser storage.

[Pixels CLI source](https://github.com/wlkr-si/ui/blob/main/scripts/pixels.mjs): Node 24+ without dependency installation. Run node scripts/pixels.mjs --grid ./mask.txt or --mask <canonical-token>; --format url, json or svg. URL/JSON preserve theme-relative null ink. SVG is a flat regular grid requiring explicit ink, separate from browser snapshot exports. It uses the same canonical codec, makes no network requests, reads no credentials and writes only stdout. See the source README for file bounds and usage.

## Contrast CLI

[Contrast CLI instructions](https://github.com/wlkr-si/ui/blob/main/README.md#contrast-cli): Node 24+ with no dependency installation. Run node scripts/contrast.mjs <foreground> <background> [--json] [--suggest]. Two opaque six-digit colours use the unchanged browser helpers. JSON keeps exact ratios and explicit AA/AAA normal/large booleans; human display rounds ratios only. Optional AA text choices use bounded 5% RGB mixes toward black/white with a fixed background. No network, credentials or file input/output.

## Installation

Start with a React/Tailwind project configured by the standard shadcn CLI. Configure the @wlkr namespace as https://ui.wlkrlabs.com/r/{name}.json.

pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add @wlkr/footer-controls

The CLI installs original source and pulls stock shadcn dependencies directly from upstream. No runtime component package, custom installer, or agent service is required.

## Components and styles

- [Copy command](/#copy-command): A copyable command with honest clipboard feedback and a manual fallback. [Source JSON](/r/copy-command.json)
- [Async action](/#async-action): Promise-aware action with pending, success, failure and retry states. [Source JSON](/r/async-action.json)
- [Filter list](/#filter-list): An accessible searchable list with accent-insensitive matching and empty states. [Source JSON](/r/filter-list.json)
- [Pixel object](/#pixel-object): A projected pixel sphere, custom point cloud, or mask with considerate motion controls. [Source JSON](/r/pixel-object.json)
- [WLKR loader](/#wlkr-loader): The original six-cell WLKR mark with considerate bars and dots loading motion. [Source JSON](/r/wlkr-loader.json)
- [WLKR theme](/#theme): Semantic light and dark tokens. Typography stays with your application. [Source JSON](/r/theme.json)
- [Page intro](/#page-intro): Gallery typography with a width-stable binary heading reveal. [Source JSON](/r/page-intro.json)
- [Index row](/#index-row): Borderless index link with three fixed digits that roll on hover and focus. [Source JSON](/r/index-row.json)
- [Text link](/#text-link): A normal text link with an optional keyboard-accessible Radix HoverCard preview. [Source JSON](/r/text-link.json)
- [Theme toggle](/#theme-toggle): Basic shadcn Toggle with light, dark and system-aware persistence. [Source JSON](/r/theme-toggle.json)
- [WLKR typography](/#typography): Opt-in exact gallery typography and layout, with semantic legacy token bridges. [Source JSON](/r/typography.json)
- [Footer controls](/#footer-controls): Quiet system/light/dark controls with a real app-owned plain-text agent link. [Source JSON](/r/footer-controls.json)
- [GitHub star](/#github-star): A native repository link with an app-supplied count, rolling digits, green star fill, and a bounded burst. [Source JSON](/r/github-star.json)
